GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well ent looking for the lead & got it briefly, balanced up second taking a trail 2 Lengths (1400m), no change & travelled well 600, cornered Ridden Along awaiting gap, Clear 200 Under Whip held Ground only # couldn't dash

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths 3 Wide With Cover turning, couldn't come on in straight. [Stewards: Pulled early/middle stages.] # weak in Straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, with cover, in the early and middle stages. Pulled in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths 3 Wide , Restrained and Drifted Back , in Two Wide at 900m, Hooked Out 3 Wide at 600m, Moved Up to 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, improved little in Straight # mostly wide/plugged
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When caught wide in the early stages was eased back to a position worse than midfield passing the 1200m. Raced three wide, without cover, in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, railed to 3.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn to the cutaway, railed to Lead at 150m, Headed 50m from post. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start. Pulled middle stages.] # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Pulled in the middle stages. Rounding the home turn became held up for clear running and was unable to be fully tested until near the 350m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3 Wide , made no ground to Turn then Held Ground drifting in feild in Straight # always Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by the 1000m, Made Some Ground to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Up home turn to 300m then shifted Four Wide and Made Some Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rounding the home turn became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 300m. Hung in under pressure from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6th 5 Lengths 800m Hooked Out 3 Wide 5th home turn 3 Wide 5th weakened final 200m Checked nearly fell 150m Stewards: clipped heels near 200m # wide/tired/chk 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages. Near the 200m, clipped heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up to 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, couldn't come on in Straight # no excuses
Jumped Ok , Drifted Back last 10 Lengths 800m, did nothing # always out back

Jumped well. Rolled fwd 3 Wide until raced 5th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Stayed same until improving keenly 3 Wide from 800m. Improved to =lead 3 Wide @ 500m. Pushed to quicken =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 800m was directed outwards after pulling its way up onto heels. Raced three wide, without cover, from this point.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 1000m, Hard Ridden and Beaten Straightening Up , weakened in Straight # on pace/weakened

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with a runner.
